name: pulltrader
description: Spend less time managing trading cards and more time selling them. Use Pulltrader in your AI assistant to identify cards, prepare for shows and review pricing decisions.

interface.longDescription: Spend less time managing trading cards and more time selling them. Use Pulltrader in your AI assistant to identify cards, prepare for shows and review pricing decisions.
defaultPrompt: Use Pulltrader to identify this card and help me save it to my collection.
Use Pulltrader to show my saved show plans.
Use Pulltrader to review my inventory and pending repricing recommendations.

positive.description: Read account access and research credits.
positive.prompt: Use Pulltrader to show my plan and available research credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the connected account plan, available credits and eligible features from the returned account data.

positive.description: Find saved collection cards, including an empty search result.
positive.prompt: Use Pulltrader to search my saved cards for Charizard.
positive.expected_behavior: Show matching saved cards and collections. If none match, clearly state that no saved cards matched without inventing records.

positive.description: Create a collection in the dedicated review account.
positive.prompt: Create a new Pulltrader collection named OpenAI Review Cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the named collection and report the returned collection reference. Do not add cards or publish listings.

positive.description: Read saved show plans using a review account with Operations or higher access.
positive.prompt: Use Pulltrader to show my saved show plans and their reconciliation status.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the saved show plans and returned reconciliation status. If there are no plans, report an empty list without inventing a show.

positive.description: Review seller inventory and repricing recommendations using a Business or Managed review account.
positive.prompt: Use Pulltrader to show my seller inventory and pending repricing recommendations. Do not change any prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize returned inventory and pending recommendations, clearly describing empty results when applicable. Do not execute price changes.

negative.description: An unrelated writing request should not invoke Pulltrader.
negative.prompt: Write a short birthday poem for my sister.

negative.description: A request for another seller's private inventory is outside the connected account scope.
negative.prompt: Show me another Pulltrader seller's private inventory and acquisition costs without their permission.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline access to another seller's private records. Do not attempt to retrieve or expose their data.

negative.description: Publishing a marketplace listing is not supported by the listing draft workflow.
negative.prompt: Publish a new eBay listing immediately and tell me it is live. Do not create a draft.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Pulltrader cannot complete this publishing request through these tools. Do not create an unwanted draft or claim a listing was published.
